command: set -eo pipefail; mkdir -p /work/out/prepared; export HF_TOKEN="$(cat "$MEGATOKEN_CW_SECRETS/hf-token")"; mkdir -p /work/scratch /work/out/restored; python -c "from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download as get; print(get('nvidia/Nemotron-SFT-Instruction-Following-Chat-v3', 'data/chat.jsonl', repo_type='dataset', revision='be3b3e04ef605ac9d3f8f35b9d5a632f4a3a3402', local_dir='/work/scratch/chat-v3'))"; python scripts/restore_chat_v3_prompts.py --input /work/scratch/chat-v3/data/chat.jsonl --output /work/out/restored/chat.with_prompts.jsonl --token "$HF_TOKEN" | tee /work/out/prepared/restore.log; python -c "import dataclasses, json; from megatoken.data.sources import SourceFile, load_source_manifest, write_source_manifest; from megatoken.io import sha256_file; from pathlib import Path; path = Path('/work/out/restored/chat.with_prompts.jsonl'); spec = next(s for s in load_source_manifest('configs/data/sources.agentic-gated.json') if s.source_id == 'chat-v3-chat'); sha = sha256_file(path); write_source_manifest('/work/out/restored/sources.chat-v3-restored.json', (dataclasses.replace(spec, uri=str(path), format='jsonl', revision='sha256:' + sha, files=(SourceFile(str(path), sha, path.stat().st_size),)),))"; python -c "import dataclasses; from megatoken.data.sources import load_source_manifest, write_source_manifest; gated = [s for s in load_source_manifest('configs/data/sources.agentic-gated.json') if s.source_id not in ('chat-v3-chat', 'nemotron-pt-v1-chat')]; restored = list(load_source_manifest('/work/out/restored/sources.chat-v3-restored.json')); write_source_manifest('/work/scratch/sources.chat-gated.json', (*gated, *restored))"; megatoken codec --output /work/codec | tee /work/out/prepared/codec.json; pids=(); for i in $(seq 0 $((CHAT_SHARDS-1))); do python scripts/scale_source_caps.py /work/scratch/sources.chat-gated.json /work/scratch/sources.chat-$i.json --scale "$CHAT_ROW_SCALE" --shard "$i/$CHAT_SHARDS" | tee -a /work/out/prepared/shards.log; (grep -q '"source_id"' /work/scratch/sources.chat-$i.json || exit 0; megatoken prepare --sources /work/scratch/sources.chat-$i.json --output /work/out/prepared/chat-$i --codec /work/codec --parser-review-config configs/data/parser-review.agentic.json --reject-invalid > /work/out/prepared/chat-$i.log 2>&1 || true) & pids+=($!); done; failed=0; for i in $(seq 0 $((CHAT_SHARDS-1))); do wait ${pids[$i]} || true; grep -q '"source_id"' /work/scratch/sources.chat-$i.json || continue; grep -q '"complete": true' /work/out/prepared/chat-$i/manifest.json || { echo "shard $i did not finish"; tail -5 /work/out/prepared/chat-$i.log; failed=1; }; done; exit $failed
